forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+---
+depends_on:
+- 01KY7EDAAEV7M16J19CESQ54ZR
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8580'
+title: Slash-command registry + dispatch at the prompt owner
+---
+Plan §6.2 + head decisions. Registry mechanics here (vocabulary from Extras): merge with precedence (builtins reserved; provider < user < project), collision logging, near-miss matching, commandUpdates re-publication. Builtins bind to session surface: /compact → session.compact(), /context → usage/fill, /status → id/cwd/model/transcript path, /help. Dotfolder commands/*.md load via stack + untrusted Stencil as .prompt-only (data never becomes .action). Dispatch in this package's prompt() and exposed for frontend composers: leading /name routes through the registry BEFORE anything reaches the model — unknown /name errors with near-matches, never a model turn; /compact typed in an editor must never become a prompt.
\ No newline at end of file
